arguments.summary: Initial ontology (ontology_v0) for the Lumo Outdoors SQLite shop database (customers, orders, order_items, payments, products, refunds). It grounds the business glossary definitions (valid order, item amount, net revenue, average order value, repeat customer, received amount, refund-report amount) in observed columns, records code meanings for status/channel/tier/region/payment/product, the cents-vs-TWD unit difference, the UTC-to-Taipei reporting rule, and the two different refund period attributions. All 10 construction questions (C01-C10) are linked to supporting objects. Structural validation only; no task accuracy is claimed.
limitations: UTC storage of order_ts / refund_ts and the Taipei (UTC+8) reporting rule come only from the business glossary; the data (uniform hour-of-day, no zone marker) cannot confirm it.
Sales quantity (銷售數量) is not defined in the glossary; valid-order basis is an assumption (low confidence), though it did not change the top-ranked active product in the construction data.
The basis of '占比' (order count vs amount) is not stated; order-count basis is assumed (medium confidence).
Customer tier and region are current-state values only; historical tier/region at order time is unavailable.
products.is_active is a current flag without history.
Refund reason codes (R1-R4), coupon_code, signup_date and payments.paid_ts are in the data/glossary but not required by the construction workload and are intentionally not modeled.
No equivalence relations were created: no pair of Terms was found that expresses the same concept in different columns without differing semantics.
